name: Graffiti Art
tagline: White graffiti deck with neon spray paint, black marker doodles, hand-lettered titles, circular tags, arrows, X marks, and photo collage blocks.

palette.description: White canvas with neon lime, cyan, magenta, soft blue spray gradients, black marker strokes, and occasional photo blocks.

typography.style: Loose marker-like display type with compact sans captions and sprayed color accents.

best_for: Street-art education, graffiti workshops, creative presentations, campaign moodboards, and expressive youth-focused decks.
avoid_for: Formal investor decks, calm luxury decks, or dense compliance materials.

source_inspiration.name: SlidesCarnival Graffiti Style
source_inspiration.notes: Rebuilt as source-inspired portable HTML/CSS from public visual references; no source asset files are embedded.
